title: Saasment Monitored Application Structure
description: JSON structure documentation for a SaaS application monitored by Saasment for security posture management

name.description: Application display name (e.g., Microsoft 365, Salesforce, Okta)

category.description: Application category: Identity & Access Management, Collaboration, CRM, DevOps, HR, Finance, etc.

connected.description: Whether the Saasment integration is active and data is being collected

posture_score.description: Security posture score 0-100 reflecting configuration health for this application

misconfiguration_count.description: Number of open security misconfigurations detected in this application

last_scanned.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent security scan
